'''Brontosaurus Rex''' is a character who is mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
Rex is a wrestler who competed for the [[Intergalactic Wrestling Title]] in [[1992]].

He is described as a "''wrestling caveman who drags his woman around the ring by her hair''". He was scheduled to face [[Thunderbeast]] next. It is unknown whether he won or not.
